Agri Insights

Why Shade Net Is Required

1

Weather Protection

Shields plants from natural weather disturbances of all kinds.

2

Optimal Growing Climate

Balances light, temperature and humidity for healthy plant growth.

3

Prevents Heat Stress

Guards against plant burn and overheating inside the structure.

4

Storm Barrier

Protects crops from heavy rain, high winds and hailstorms.

5

Reduces Evaporation

Lowers water loss, helping conserve irrigation resources.

6

Right Shade Level

A 30–50% shade factor is ideal for vegetables and flowers.

Specification
Twin size: 2 / 2.5 / 3 / 4 mmMesh size: 30 / 35 / 40 / 50 / 100 mmRope: 12 mm

Product Specification · Safety Nets

Knotless Safety Net

Mesh & twin specification

Mesh

  • Uniform mesh structure for balanced performance
  • Consistent geometry for better strength & load distribution
  • Breaking strength: 134 kgf

Twin

  • Size: 3 mm / 2.5 mm
  • Breaking strength: 105 kgf (ISO 1806:2002)

Structural Integrity

  • Completely smooth, uniform finish
  • Retains full material strength across the joint
  • Low resistance — smooth glide, minimal drag

Knotless Construction

Higher abrasion resistance — friction distributed evenly and concrete releases easily. Interlocked, continuous woven pattern for uniform strength across every joint.

Mesh sizes: 30 · 35 · 50 mm, each with 3 mm twinColours: Green, Blue, or custom

Scaffolding Net: The Sirius Upgrade

Comparing traditional scaffolding nets with our 100 GSM mono-fabric solution — stronger protection, longer life, better value.

Material Strength

Longevity

Product Specification · Concrete Protection

Mono Mesh Net — 120 to 320 GSM

Square-mesh monofilament net engineered for concrete-pour protection on high-rise construction sites.

Advanced Performance

  • 120–320 GSM square mesh monofilament net
  • Mesh size 8 mm × 8 mm
  • Bursting strength 13.1 kg/cm² (IS 1966 Part 1:2022)
  • Tensile strength 66.9 (IS 1969 Part 1:2024)

Site Benefits

  • Allows natural air flow; aggregate does not pass through
  • Slurry passes through — no blockage
  • Mivan pin does not pass through the net
  • Reduces wind pressure; no damage to pipes or brackets

Very good for high-rise floors and easy to clean.

MESH SIZE: 8 × 8 mm

Safety Classification

Fire Safety Rating

Flame-Retardant Monofilament Net (FR). Standard plastic nets can melt into hot, dripping liquid fire that rapidly ignites material below. An FR mono net prevents this risk.

V-0Best performance
Extinguish time

Self-extinguishes within 10 seconds

Drip behaviour

Cannot produce flaming drips

V-1Intermediate
Extinguish time

Self-extinguishes within 20 seconds

Drip behaviour

May produce flaming drips

V-2Lowest rating
Extinguish time

Self-extinguishes within 25 seconds

Drip behaviour

Greater chance of flaming drips
